title: Zombiefield
description:
Welcome to Zombiefield operations! Your contract is to activate enough portals to lure in the toughest zombies and evacuate. Follow these rules to complete your mission and get paid:

Paid Objectives✅ Open portals (Based on threat level)

✅ Restore power (Based on threat level)

✅ Control zombie population if necessary ($1 per body)

✅ Complete the contract ($1000 upon evacuation procedure)

Recommendations👥 1 Manager (beard, one life) leads and is responsible for the operation

👥 Up to 3 Employees (shaved, unlimited respawn) should protect Manager at all costs

Important Notes⚠️ No place is safe. Stick together and stay moving

⚠️ Research shows that teamwork increases survival chances by 8%

⚠️ Portals and power outlets raises your hazard pay but also increases threat levels

⚠️ Do not take teammates' ammuniition from drop deliveries

⚠️ Injuries during mission time and required supplies will not be compensated

GAMEPLAY:• Buy and Use weapons/ammo to keep the field clear of zombies and get money

• Open portals and restore power to bring tougher zombies into the field and get money

• Once the threat level reaches its peak, our company will send evacuation transport

• If a Manager dies, the operation contract becomes void

FEATURES:• Hazard pay for tasks, plus extra for each zombie you defeated

• Choose Weapons to buy from a variety of single-shot and automatic models

• Call (by phone on your table) for helicopter delivery and get chosen gear right to your shack

• New zombie species are attracted through each new opened portal, increasing quantity and difficulty
description_short: Zombiefielders! Your mission is to open portals to attract stronger zombies and evacuate from the field. Work with your manager to reduce operational risks and get paid for completing your contract
